! go-jsonschema validate --schema schema.json --output basic instance.json
# Multi-error collection: both /properties/a/type and /properties/b/type
# must appear as separate entries in basic's flat Errors list.
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/properties/a/type"'
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/properties/b/type"'
stdout '"instanceLocation":"/a"'
stdout '"instanceLocation":"/b"'

-- schema.json --
{
  "properties": {
    "a": { "type": "string" },
    "b": { "type": "integer" }
  }
}
-- instance.json --
{"a": 1, "b": "x"}
